description: Near high/low alarm: may the daily-candle series of the fallback chain (Binance, Binance.US, Coinbase — never the pair's own exchange) be used? Android NearExtreme.seriesAllowed / iOS NearExtreme.seriesAllowed. Same rule as the mini chart (SheetChart.sparklineFor + TokenIdentity.fallbackSeriesAllowed): nameAllowed = no clear name conflict; lastClose = last close of the series in its currency; rate = factor pair quote -> series currency (1 for the same currency, e.g. CHF -> USDT ~1.13); allowed only when |price × rate / lastClose − 1| ≤ 0.25. Missing/invalid price, last close or rate = not checkable = false (no alarm rather than another token's high/low). null stands for a missing value.
